title: OVERHAULED Modpack
description: Optimized Vanilla Expanded Refined Hyper Advanced Ultimate Limitless Epic Dynamic(OVERHAULED) Modpack
body:
Do you want a Minecraft experience that stays completely true to Vanilla, but runs smoother and looks better than ever before? Looking for a pack packed with every optimization and FPS-boosting mod you could ever dream of? Then OVERHAULED is the modpack for you!

  Built for version 1.21.11, OVERHAULED is a vanilla-friendly, client-side powerhouse designed to elevate your game without changing a single core mechanic. Whether you are surviving in Hardcore, building in Creative, or diving into light PvP, this pack enhances your gameplay while keeping the Minecraft soul intact.


  Don't let the numbers fool you! While it boasts 131 total modifications, every single one has been hand-picked to ensure the game still feels 100% Vanilla.

- 94 Optimization & Client-Side Mods: Massive FPS boosts, reduced stuttering, and seamless performance whether you're playing single-player or on your favorite multiplayer server.

- 35 Vanilla+ Resource Packs: Subtle visual tweaks to items, blocks, and UI that polish the game's aesthetic without ruining its classic charm.

- 2 Legendary Shader Packs: Take your visuals to the next level. Choose Iris for a stunningly realistic look, or Complementary for that enhanced, cinematic Minecraft feel.

  
  OVERHAULED is perfect for anyone who loves the standard game but wants it better. It is fully compatible with vanilla servers and tailored for:

- Survival & Hardcore players who want immersive visuals and stable performance.

- Light PvP enthusiasts who need every frame per second they can get.

- Creative builders who want their masterpieces to look breathtaking.

Get ready to experience Minecraft the way it was meant to be played. I hope you enjoy the OVERHAULED Modpack!
